nasi_lemak.health_notes: A coconut rice dish often served with sambal, anchovies, and peanuts. High in saturated fat from coconut milk.

roti_canai.health_notes: Flaky flatbread typically served with dhal or curry. Moderate calories per piece.

char_kuey_teow.health_notes: Stir-fried flat rice noodles wok-fried with soy sauce. High in fat and sodium.

nasi_goreng.health_notes: Malaysian fried rice with spices and vegetables. Calorie content varies with added protein.

laksa.health_notes: Spicy noodle soup with coconut or tamarind base. Can be high in sodium.

satay.health_notes: Grilled skewered meat served with peanut sauce. Good protein source per skewer.

rendang.health_notes: Slow-cooked dry curry with coconut and spices. Rich in protein but also in fat.

roti_tissue.health_notes: Crispy cone-shaped roti often drizzled with condensed milk or sugar. High in sugar and carbs.

cendol.health_notes: Iced dessert with pandan jelly, coconut milk, and palm sugar. High in sugar.

teh_tarik.health_notes: Pulled milk tea. Contains caffeine and added sugar depending on preparation.

murtabak.health_notes: Stuffed pan-fried flatbread with minced meat and egg. Calorie-dense meal option.
